m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read this skill's global-crew.md and global-everyone.md, the project deltas docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md and docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, the handoff g1-implement-handoff.md, and the current source of src/physics/layer2/arcs.py, src/physics/layer2/session_braking.py (actual call-site check), src/physics/layer2/braking_report.py, src/physics/layer2/grip_bin_obs.py, src/physics/physics_data_models.py (_VALID_REGIMES), src/physics/constants.py (GRAVITY_MS2), and tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_arcs.py. Verify handoff completeness and that identify_braking_arcs's real signature matches the handoff's description. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff loaded; handoff complete; identify_braking_arcs real signature confirmed against handoff

m1-generalize-contiguous-runs.title: Generalize _contiguous_runs to accept a regimes set; identify_braking_arcs unchanged externally
m1-generalize-contiguous-runs.imperative: Edit src/physics/layer2/arcs.py: change _contiguous_runs(samples, min_len) to _contiguous_runs(samples, min_len, regimes: set[str]) matching against `s.regime in regimes` instead of the hardcoded single-regime equality check. Update identify_braking_arcs's body to call _contiguous_runs(samples, min_len, {_BRAKE_REGIME}) -- its own public signature (identify_braking_arcs(samples, min_len=3, frontier_decel_quantile=0.6)) and behavior stay byte-identical for existing callers (braking_report.py:plot_arcs). Run the existing test_arcs.py suite -- all pre-existing tests must still pass unmodified.

postconditions.statement: _contiguous_runs generalized (regimes param, no duplicated logic); identify_braking_arcs signature/behavior unchanged; all 3 pre-existing test_arcs.py tests pass

m2-straight-arcs.title: Add StraightArc dataclass + identify_straight_arcs, mirroring BrakingArc pattern
m2-straight-arcs.imperative: In src/physics/layer2/arcs.py add: frozen dataclass StraightArc(sample_indices: list[int], length_m: float, duration_s: float, top_speed_ms: float) with a docstring citing the physical formula for each field; identify_straight_arcs(samples, min_len) grouping contiguous samples whose regime is in {'straight_throttle','straight_coast','straight_brake'} (the non-'corner' members of src.physics.physics_data_models._VALID_REGIMES) via the now-generalized _contiguous_runs, applying the same min_len convention identify_braking_arcs uses. length_m = cumulative straight-line position delta over the run (matches BrakingArc's own field-computation style); duration_s = (last.timestamp_ms - first.timestamp_ms) / 1000.0; top_speed_ms = max(sample.speed for sample in run). Add test classes to tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_arcs.py covering: contiguous straight runs across all 3 straight regimes become one StraightArc, a corner sample breaks the run, min_len filtering, and the four field computations on a synthetic fixture. Do not remove or weaken any existing test.

preconditions.statement: m1 complete: _contiguous_runs generalized and existing tests green

postconditions.statement: StraightArc + identify_straight_arcs implemented and new tests pass alongside all pre-existing test_arcs.py tests

constraints: reuse _contiguous_runs, do not duplicate its loop

m3-corner-descriptors.title: New src/physics/layer2/corner_descriptors.py: bin_row_to_descriptor + descriptors_from_frame
m3-corner-descriptors.imperative: Create src/physics/layer2/corner_descriptors.py with: bin_row_to_descriptor(mu_lat_p90: float, v_mean: float) -> tuple[float, float] returning (radius_m, lateral_g) where lateral_g = mu_lat_p90 (already g-units per grip_bin_obs.py docstring, do NOT re-divide by G) and radius_m = v_mean**2 / (mu_lat_p90 * GRAVITY_MS2) (import GRAVITY_MS2 from src.physics.constants); guard degenerate input (mu_lat_p90 <= 0 or NaN in either input) by raising ValueError -- document this choice in the docstring along with the v^2/(mu*g) circular-motion derivation. descriptors_from_frame(df: pandas.DataFrame) -> numpy.ndarray shape (N,2) columns [radius_m, lateral_g], one row per surviving grip_bin_obs-shaped row (columns mu_lat_p90, v_mean), DROPPING (not erroring on) rows where mu_lat_p90 <= 0 or NaN in either column. Write tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_corner_descriptors.py covering: normal (radius, lateral_g) computation against hand-computed expected values, the ValueError guard for mu_lat_p90<=0 and for NaN inputs, descriptors_from_frame drops bad rows and returns the right shorter shape, and an all-good frame returns full N rows in the right column order.

preconditions.statement: m2 complete: StraightArc/identify_straight_arcs implemented and green

postconditions.statement: corner_descriptors.py implemented; new test_corner_descriptors.py all pass

constraints: GRAVITY_MS2 imported from src.physics.constants, never hardcoded 9.81
mu_lat_p90 is already g-units -- no re-division by G
no DB I/O, pure functions only

m4-full-evidence.title: Full required-evidence run + simplification_limits + write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT
m4-full-evidence.imperative: Run the exact Required Evidence command from the handoff (both test files together, -v), confirm pre-existing test_arcs.py case count is unchanged (count before/after) and all pass. Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits over the touched src/ and tests/ paths per project norm. Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT to .agent-work/625-segmentation-substrate/crew-handoffs/g1-implement-result.md using the template, citing the _contiguous_runs before/after signature diff hunk as required evidence. Attach it as evidence e-g1-implement-result via attach --type implementer-result.

preconditions.statement: m3 complete: corner_descriptors.py implemented and green

postconditions.statement: combined required-evidence test run passes, all cases including pre-existing ones
